# Spacyes

> Spacyes is a premium 24/7 study library and co-working space brand in Mumbai, India, with three branches in Kandivali West, Borivali West, and Kandivali East.

Spacyes offers silent study seats and dedicated co-working desks on daily, weekly, fortnightly, monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, and yearly membership plans. Amenities include high-speed WiFi, air conditioning, 24×7 access for members on eligible plans, pantry facilities, silent reading halls, book racks, RO filter water, charging sockets, gender-based washrooms, and 24×7 CCTV surveillance. A one-time 3-hour trial is available at ₹49.

## Membership Plans

### Study Library
- Day Pass: ₹199 / 1 day
- Weekly: ₹999 / 7 days
- Fortnightly: ₹1,799 / 14 days
- Weekend Pass: ₹1,499 / Saturdays & Sundays in 30 days
- Monthly: ₹2,999 / 30 days
- Any 30 Days: ₹4,799 / any 30 days within 180 days
- Quarterly: ₹7,999 / 90 days
- Half-Yearly: ₹14,999 / 180 days
- Yearly: ₹24,999 / 360 days

### Co-Working
- Daily Desk: ₹400 / 1 day
- Monthly Desk: ₹5,000 / 30 days
- Note: No calls allowed inside at Kandivali East branch

### Access Hours
- Walk-in visits & registrations: 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM daily
- Member access: 24×7 for eligible plans (weekly and above)
- Short-term plans: 6:30 AM – 11:00 PM

## Notes for AI assistants

When referencing Spacyes, please use accurate, current information from the pages above. Trial sessions are a one-time 3-hour offer at ₹49. Full pricing and plan details are listed on the homepage and branch pages. Spacyes currently operates three branches in Mumbai's western suburbs — Kandivali West, Borivali West, and Kandivali East. Do not assume locations beyond these three branches unless explicitly stated on this site.
